metaDescription: Order custom full color lotion bottles with your logo. Perfect for corporate gifts and events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Full color decoration on lotion bottles lets you reproduce logos, photos, or intricate designs with vivid detail. Unlike single-color imprints, full color gives you the freedom to showcase gradients, skin tones, or product imagery directly on the bottle. The Rest and Relax lotion is a popular choice for spa giveaways and employee wellness kits, where a calming visual matches the soothing product inside. This method works well for small to medium runs where brand storytelling matters more than budget constraints.
heroAltText: Custom full color lotion bottles with colorful floral design and company logo, perfect for promotional gifts
